features: ⚠️ THIS VERSION ADDS A MIGRATION: it moves the supplier categories into the database, where before they were written by a seeder. It applies itself with the update, touches no existing data, and does nothing at all on an installation that already has those categories.

SUPPLIER CATEGORIES ARE NOW YOURS — They were nine fixed rows with no way to change them. Now there is a page (Address book → Suppliers → «Manage categories») to create, rename and delete them. And next to the «Supplier category» dropdown on the supplier form there is a «+» that creates one on the spot and leaves it selected, without losing what you have already typed.

AND THERE ARE NINETEEN, NOT NINE — Ten join the original nine: heating engineer, aerial and entryphone, locksmith and fittings, painter, drain cleaning, pest control, concierge, insurance, utilities, professional firms. They are a starting point: any fixed list is wrong for somebody, which is why the button to make your own is the real feature.

⚠️ «SHOW ME ALL THE PLUMBERS»: THE PROGRAM CAN NOW ANSWER — A supplier's category already reached your browser on every row of the list, and no screen showed it: no column, no filter. Measured on a real installation, six suppliers out of eight had no category — not because the right ones were missing, but because filling it in did nothing. The supplier list now has a «Category» column and a filter that accepts more than one at a time, and in the categories page the name links straight to the filtered list.

YOU CAN SEE — AND REACH — WHOEVER USES A CATEGORY — Next to each category are the initials of the suppliers using it: open the panel, see them all with their address, and go into their record from there. A category in use cannot be deleted — those suppliers would be left without one — and instead of a flat «no» a window tells you who, with the link to go and change it.

⚠️ A PERSON NOW HAS A RECORD — In the address book, clicking a person's name opened a completely blank page: not an error, simply nothing. The defect predates this version. There is now a real record, built like the supplier one, with two tabs: «Details» (contacts, the units they occupy with role and share, the buildings, the ID document, and whether they have access to the private area) and «Documents», where the person's own documents live — ID copy, proxies, contracts — uploaded, renamed and deleted just like on the supplier record.

DETAILS — A supplier's representatives in the list are now clickable and lead to the person's record. The count in the panels said «1 Totali» and now reads properly, in the buildings and units lists too. The ATECO code search no longer presents two codes as «the ones most needed here», because that field holds the supplier's code, not yours. And the supplier document upload no longer promises images, which the program currently rejects.
